note: Independent re-judgment after BGP export-chain next-hop unification (cabc8c511e / c2d7117d05). Verified RFC 8893 Section 1 ('Any AS_PATH modifications resulting in effective origin AS change MUST be taken into account.'), policyview/rpki_origin.go (EffectiveOriginAS), peer_forward_facts.go (buildForwardFacts), peer_settings.go (SessionFacts), and both tagged tests. PeerSettings removed NextHopMode/NextHopAddress, buildForwardFacts switched to export-chain next-hop precomputation while keeping ASOverride and SecondaryAS propagation intact, and live-forward subtests in rfc8893_egress_validation_test.go replaced NextHopMode=NextHopUnchanged with BuiltinNextHopUnchanged. Q1: positive covers all five effective-origin-changing mechanisms (remove-private-as strip to empty -> LocalAS, remove-private-as peer-as replacement -> PeerAS, live-forwarded as-override -> LocalAS, RFC 7705 SecondaryAS on empty AS_PATH, and external raw AS_PATH rewrite); negative verifies live-forwarded as-override and RFC 7705 SecondaryAS flipping to unauthorized origins reject while transit-only as-override preserves rightmost Valid origin. Q2: ignoring any of the five AS_PATH modifications or miscomputing origin AS fails exact accept/reject and socket-output assertions. Q3: VRPs authorize only the expected post-modification origin (or only the stale origin on negative) and BuiltinNextHopUnchanged does not alter AS_PATH. Q4: covers every egress AS_PATH modification mechanism in Ze.
